name: Cheesy Sweet Potato "Tostadas" with Beans, Mango Salsa & Tangy Arugula

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the middle of the oven. Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2.04 kg sweet potatoes
3 jalapeño peppers
1 ½ mangoes
1 ½ red bell peppers
1 small bunch cilantro
3 limes
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard ends of sweet potatoes; peel and slice lengthwise into ½-inch thick pieces. Discard any small, outer slices, then divide remaining slices between baking sheets.
Drizzle sweet potato slices with oil and season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp cumin

instructions.primary_message: Place one baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping sweet potatoes halfway through, until fork-tender, 8-12 minutes. (Keep a close watch on the sweet potatoes to avoid burning.) Repeat with 2nd baking sheet.

Meanwhile, quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice and place in a medium bowl. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince garlic and onion. Add both to the bowl with the jalapeños.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
½ medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pits, starting with the flat sides. Small dice and add to the bowl.
Seed and small dice bell peppers; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Juice half the limes (reserving the rest for the salad) into the bowl; add salt and stir to combine the mango salsa. Set aside.

Drain and rinse beans. Divide beans between sweet potato slices, spreading them out in an even layer; season with salt. Working in batches, return sweet potatoes to the oven and broil until beans are heated through, about 2 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans black beans
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince additional garlic; place in a large bowl.
Juice remaining limes into the bowl with the garlic. Add oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing. Add arugula and toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp pure maple syrup
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Divide sweet potato "tostadas" between plates; top with mango salsa and crumbled goat cheese. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
